text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Trainer and Kris S, stamina isn't an issue anymore. Which means next—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I need a vessel.
An 'ultimate vessel' capable of responding to the new me.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, tomorrow is finally
the fourth "Upgrade Exam."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: ...Mun!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
...See? Thanks to weight training,
I'm already plenty buff now, aren't I?
choice_data_list: No... I wouldn't go quite that far...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: I see. But with the current ST-2, it's starting to lack power. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow I will deploy the improved new body.
It is precisely what I had originally envisioned—"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
The true form of ST-2.
Its ultimate evolution.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
All will be revealed tomorrow.
Along with an immense shock, that is.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Thank you all for gathering here. Well then, it is finally time to unveil it. This is—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: It's ST-2's final evolved form!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Oooooh...!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Not only has the maximum output increased, but its points of articulation are now virtually identical to an Umamusume's—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"I can do this, too.
And then—"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"I can do things like this too.
Truth be told, I can also do the Awa dance and scarf holds, but..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Kesa-gatame... Hmm, jujitsu is
famous in Brazil too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, that won't be necessary.
It's not like we're playing a fighting game."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: And so, let's head in right away.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Dive in!!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, power is surging through me...!
Am I myself right now, or am I ST-2?

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
No, it might actually be a new mechanical lifeform
that encompasses both.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, indeed. The union of the Frost Wolf and the Flame God
brought forth... a true demigod.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, we won't know its true value until we test it.
If you can't maintain your balance, running properly will be out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And the software too. If that's a mess, it's nothing more than a wooden puppet.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, talk big while you still can.
Do not underestimate the power
of the new model ST-2.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Come at me if you dare!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Every last one of them together!
choice_data_list: Aren't you trying a bit too hard to show off?

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, that's true... Unfortunately, I don't have the speed
to take them all on at once yet. But...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
"We should be able to put up a decent fight.
Well then, <chrname>, I'm counting on you."
